ai_hints: Kubernetes: missing resource requests/limits, probes absent or too aggressive, securityContext gaps (runAsNonRoot, readOnlyRootFilesystem, dropped capabilities), secrets in plain manifests, selectors/labels that no longer match, replica/PDB settings that reduce availability, RBAC wildcards, rolling-update settings that cause downtime.

message.es: Da acceso casi total al host. Elimina privileged o concede solo capabilities concretas.
message.en: Gives near-total host access. Remove privileged or grant only specific capabilities.

message.es: Rompe el aislamiento del pod. Justifica y limita su alcance.
message.en: Breaks pod isolation. Justify and limit its scope.

message.es: Usa runAsNonRoot: true y allowPrivilegeEscalation: false.
message.en: Use runAsNonRoot: true and allowPrivilegeEscalation: false.

message.es: Despliegues no reproducibles. Fija un tag inmutable o digest.
message.en: Non-reproducible deployments. Pin an immutable tag or digest.
